messages:
mike_support: heads up — customer on Private VPC reporting intermittent stream failures to inference endpoints since ~09:10 UTC. ~1 in 10 requests get a TLS reset mid-stream, others succeed. They rolled a firewall rule change ~09:05.
anya_se: thanks — do we have a repro + tcpdump/curl? which region / nat gateway?
mike_support: repro steps: 1) from customer host in private subnet run:
```bash
curl -v --http2 "https://inference.example.redwood/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Output sometimes shows: ```* TLS handshake read: error:1408F10B:SSL routines:ssl3_get_record:wrong version number
* Connection #0 to host inference.example.redwood left intact
```
I've attached a short tcpdump: shows SYN, SYN/ACK, ACK, then TLS ClientHello, then RST from client after ~250ms.
raj_infra: that pattern screams return-path or NAT ephemeral/port reuse issues. If NAT runs out of ephemeral ports or NACL denies return ephemeral range it'll tear mid-handshake.
katie_network: I pulled the customer's VPC NACL + SG: NACL has an explicit DENY for 32768-65535 (rule 120) and only allows 443/80 outbound earlier. Security group outbound allows 443 but not a wide ephemeral range. Remember NACLs are stateless — you must permit both directions for ephemeral ports.
mike_support: confirmed NACL listing (copied):
```
Rule 100: ALLOW TCP 443 0.0.0.0/0
Rule 110: ALLOW TCP 80 0.0.0.0/0
Rule 120: DENY ALL 32768-65535 0.0.0.0/0
Rule *: DENY ALL 
```
So return traffic from inference egress uses high source ports and client sees RST when replies are blocked.
anya_se: can you patch the NACL on a staging subnet to allow ephemeral 32768-65535 both inbound and outbound and retest? Also confirm NAT gateway port allocation metrics (AWS: NatGatewayAllocatedPorts).
mike_support: patched staging NACL to ALLOW 32768-65535 both directions, retested 50+ requests — no TLS reset, streams stable. NAT allocated ports not spiking, so seems rule was the culprit.
raj_infra: additional recommendation: increase NAT pool / use one-to-one EIPs for heavy streaming, or enable source port preservation if customer's NAT device supports it to avoid ephemeral reuse. Also check any inline TLS inspection appliance — we've seen SNI-inspecting proxies rewrite ClientHello and cause handshake aborts for certain cipher suites.
katie_network: customer also has an edge IPS set to deep-inspect TLS and rewrite SNI for monitoring; that can intermittently fail on ALPN/HTTP2 and show as "wrong version number". If NACL fix still leaves flaps, request bypass for inference subnets.
mike_support: summary & plan: 1) customer will push NACL change to prod to allow ephemeral range (both directions). 2) request firewall team to exempt inference endpoints from TLS-inspect. 3) monitor for 1 hour — if flaps persist, we'll consider NAT scaling.
deploy-bot: ticket RED-98531 created by mike_support: "Private VPC intermittent TLS resets — apply ephemeral NACL allow + request TLS-inspect bypass" (priority P2).
anya_se: thanks team. mike_support — please paste customer confirmation once prod change is applied and drop the metrics here. :thumbsup:
